notes: Totals cover every discovered session in the selected provider scope before row filters or pagination. Pending includes discovered sessions not yet scheduled.
Checked means a session analysis and detector report were collected; skipped, failed and timed-out checks remain distinct from completed checks with no findings.
Findings and component issue groups can overlap. MCP server groups include their tools; do not add the two populations. Exact component selectors retain provider identity.
Each session contributes once; reports are per-session and no family expansion is performed. Snapshot contains counts and component identities, not transcript or finding text.
Page rows are bounded to 512 KiB. Rows larger than 64 KiB are explicit digest-and-size omissions; counted totals and source-row continuation remain complete.
